full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs have brought this suit on the allegation that the disputed lands, as described in schedule.1 to the plaint, originally belonged to Abdul Aziz alias Lal Miah and his five brothers who had rayati interest in the suit lands and used to cultivate the same through bargadars. At the time of the C.S. operation; Ramjan Ali and Kader Haji were bargadars in respect of the said lands and they were recorded as such in the C.S. Khatian. About a year after the Settlement Operation, the said bargadars gave up possession to the owners who, after cultivating the lands in Khas for some time, transferred these lands by 3 registered kabalas in 1923 and 1924, and one patta in 1935, to the predecessors of the plaintiffs. After acquiring these lands in the aforesaid manner; the plaintiff’s had been possessing the same till 1958 when the defendants forcibly disposed them from the land described in Schedule 11 to the plaint. Thereafter the suit was instituted on 18.12.1950 for declaration of title and recover of possession.
